q1.sampleAnswer: In the bathroom in a suburban home outside Portland, Oregon.
q1.explanationZh: 文章第一句就说，砰砰声是从波特兰郊外一所房子的浴室里传出来的。

evidence.quote: Pounding noises kept coming from the bathroom in a suburban home outside Portland, Oregon.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答 No（噪音没有变少，反而更多）

q2.rubricZh: 要点：回答否定（No, he didn’t）。
q2.explanationZh: 警察到了以后，没有回应，反而有更多砰砰声，所以噪音没有变少，回答 No。

evidence.quote: No response. Just more pounding noises.

q3.explanationZh: 警察冲进去后看到的是一个小扫地机器人，被卡在角落里不停撞淋浴门。

evidence.quote: Then, they saw it: a little robot vacuum cleaner.

q4.sampleAnswer: He was house-sitting for his nephew, who was away on business.
q4.explanationZh: 文中说这个人在帮出差的侄子看房子（house-sitting）。

evidence.quote: for his nephew, who was away on business

q5.sampleAnswer: Because when he came back after walking the dog, he heard something in the bathroom and he could see shadows moving under the door. He thought someone had broken into the house.

keyPoints.descZh: 遛狗回来听到浴室有声音、看到门下有影子在动
examples: he heard something in the bathroom
saw shadows moving under the door
thought someone had broken into the house

q5.rubricZh: 要点：①遛狗回来听到浴室有声响、看到门下影子在动；②以为有人闯入。
q5.explanationZh: 他遛狗回来，听到浴室有动静，还看到门下有影子在动，又不知道侄子有扫地机器人，就以为有小偷进了屋，所以报警。

evidence.quote: When he came back, he heard something in the bathroom.
I could see shadows moving under the door.

q6.sampleAnswer: I think the call was fun, and calling the police was the right thing to do for the man at the time. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 给出合理的看法并说明理由（如：报警是当时正确的做法/这件事很有趣）
examples: I think the call was fun, and calling the police was the right thing to do.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：只要观点明确、理由合理，并和文章内容相符即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。可以说男子不知道有机器人，报警是正常的，警察也很理解，最后大家都笑了，所以这是有趣又合理的一次报警。

evidence.quote: This is just a fun one.

q7.explanationZh: 空格前是 were，后面是 in traffic，“被困在车流里”用 stuck。

evidence.quote: The robot was stuck in a corner.

q8.explanationZh: Do you ___ your house 的意思是“你拥有自己的房子吗”，和 rent（租）相对，用 own。

evidence.quote: All of them were holding guns.

q9.explanationZh: 空格后是 him to leave，order sb. to do sth. 是“命令某人做某事”，句子是过去时，用 ordered。

evidence.quote: After shouting that they were police, they ordered the burglar

q10.explanationZh: there was no 后面要名词，“敲门但没有回应”用 response。

q11.explanationZh: kept 后面接动词的 -ing 形式，“一遍又一遍地重复他的名字”用 repeating。

q12.explanationZh: “警察刚好及时赶到”用过去式 arrived。

q13.explanationZh: None of them 的意思是“他们当中没有一个人”，后面谓语用 were（也可用 was），句子就变成否定句：None of them were holding guns.
q13.tipsZh: none of ... 表示“……中没有一个”

q14.explanationZh: 把 After shouting 改成从句 After they shouted，意思不变：After they shouted that they were police, ...
q14.tipsZh: after + 主语 + 动词 可替换 after + doing

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是“做的事”，用 What 提问；原句是过去进行时，所以 was 提前：What was the burglar trying to do?

q16.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，变一般疑问句要用 Did 开头，动词变原形 hear；疑问句里肯定句的 something 要改成 anything：Did he hear anything in the bathroom when he came back?
q16.tipsZh: something 在疑问句中常改为 anything

q17.explanationZh: 前半句是否定句（didn’t know），反意疑问部分要用肯定形式，并和主语 the man 对应用 he：did he？
q17.tipsZh: 前否后肯，主语用相应代词

q18.explanationZh: 先找主语和谓语：The police thought（警察认为）后接宾语从句 he should not be sorry for the mistake（他不该为这个错误感到抱歉）。也可以是 He thought the police should not be sorry for the mistake。
q18.tipsZh: should not be sorry for 不应该为……感到抱歉
